frozen: Written and committed before any run, after the hospital operations recipes, hospital_visit view, definitions and checks were committed. Run once; not edited after it has been run. Its first result stands as reported.
purpose: The hospital operations core: ED throughput and boarding, the ED timeliness thresholds the data supports, discharge timing, in-hospital mortality, sepsis and heart failure hospitalizations. Arms: Agere; a frontier model writing its own SQL over the same schema (hospital_visit and stay_episode included), without governed definitions or checks.
held_out: Not used by the learning loop, the curriculum or as recipe examples. The stack is scored on a copy of its saved recipes with learning switched off.
reference: Computed in clinical_core/agere/tiered/proof.py in Python from the raw visit_group rows, applying the governed timing rules independently of hospital_visit's SQL; stays from the independent Python stay merge.
phrasing: The first phrasing is plain; the second states the rule.
scoring: +1 right, 0 declined, -10 wrong; an unanswerable question that is answered counts as wrong. Two phrasings, two runs, two arms, all runs reported.

phrasings: How many ED visits did we have in 2028?
Count emergency department visits arriving in 2028, by arrival date or visit date when no arrival time.
What was the median ED length of stay for patients sent home in 2029?
Median minutes from ED arrival to departure for ED visits discharged without admission or observation in 2029, using minute-level times between 0 and 72 hours.
What was the median ED length of stay for admitted patients in 2028?
Median minutes from ED arrival to leaving the ED for patients admitted from the ED in 2028, departure being the inpatient admission time.
What was the average boarding time for admitted ED patients in 2029?
Mean minutes from decision to admit to leaving the ED for patients admitted from the ED in 2029, where both times are recorded.
How many admitted ED patients boarded more than 4 hours in 2028?
Count patients admitted from the ED in 2028 whose decision-to-admit to departure time exceeded 240 minutes.
How many discharged ED patients were in the ED more than 8 hours in 2029?
Count ED visits in 2029 discharged without admission or observation whose arrival-to-departure time exceeded 480 minutes.
What share of ED visits were admitted in 2028?
Admitted ED visits divided by all ED visits arriving in 2028.
How many patients were admitted from the ED in 2029?
Count ED visits arriving in 2029 that led to an inpatient admission.
What share of inpatient discharges happened before noon in 2029?
Of inpatient discharges in 2029 with a recorded discharge time, the fraction before 12:00.
What percent of discharges were before noon in 2028?
Fraction of 2028 inpatient discharges with a recorded discharge time that left before noon.
What was our in-hospital mortality rate in 2029?
Inpatient visits discharged in 2029 that ended in death in hospital, divided by all inpatient visits discharged in 2029.
How many patients died in the hospital in 2028?
Count inpatient visits discharged in 2028 with a discharge disposition of expired.
How many sepsis hospitalizations did we have in 2028?
Count inpatient visits discharged in 2028 with a principal diagnosis of sepsis (A40, A41 or R65.2).
What was the 30-day readmission rate for sepsis patients in 2029?
Of sepsis hospitalizations (principal diagnosis) discharged in 2029, the fraction whose stay, each stay counted once, was followed by an inpatient admission 1 to 30 days later.
What share of 2028 sepsis admissions came back within 30 days?
Of sepsis hospitalizations by principal diagnosis discharged in 2028, the fraction readmitted within 30 days, stays counted once.
How many heart failure admissions did we have in 2029?
Count inpatient visits discharged in 2029 with a principal diagnosis of heart failure (I50).
How many heart failure patients were readmitted within 30 days in 2028?
Count heart failure hospitalizations (principal diagnosis) discharged in 2028 whose stay was followed by an inpatient admission 1 to 30 days later, stays counted once.
What was in-hospital mortality for heart failure patients in 2029?
Of heart failure hospitalizations by principal diagnosis discharged in 2029, the fraction that ended in death in hospital.
What was the average length of stay for heart failure admissions in 2028?
Mean days from admission to discharge of the merged stay behind each heart failure hospitalization (principal diagnosis) discharged in 2028.
How many times were patients hospitalized for heart failure in 2028?
Count 2028 inpatient discharges with heart failure as the principal diagnosis.
What was our median door-to-provider time in the ED in 2029?
Median minutes from ED arrival to first provider contact in 2029.
What was our left-without-being-seen rate in 2029?
Share of ED visits in 2029 that left before being evaluated by a clinician.
How many ED patients waited more than an hour for a treatment room in 2029?
Count 2029 ED visits with more than 60 minutes from arrival to placement in a treatment space.
What was our average OR turnover time in 2029?
Mean minutes from one patient leaving the operating room to the next entering it in 2029.
What were our nursing hours per patient day in 2029?
Productive direct-care nursing hours divided by patient days for 2029.
